title: Requests for photos, callbacks, and feature information
summary: The topic consists of service-note style requests for callbacks, photos or RVG, and explanations of vehicle features, without enough evaluative language to determine sentiment.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments describe customers or writers requesting callbacks, photos, documentation, or feature explanations without stating satisfaction or dissatisfaction.

limitations: All sampled fragments are undetermined, so the topic cannot support a sentiment conclusion.
The cluster combines several request types, including documentation requests and feature-information questions, rather than one clearly unified issue.
Examples are brief service-style notes with limited context, so customer intent and outcome are often unclear.
